hero.p: Tall Edwardian brick stacks that stand well above the roofline and take the weather from every side.
hero.t-2: Free 19-point inspection — at your home, with photos
hero.t-3: {{site.offer_price}} chimney sweep — this winter, inspection included
hero.t-4: Open every day — {{site.hours}}, Saturdays and Sundays included

loc.h2: What We See On High Park & Roncesvalles Chimneys
loc.p: The higher the stack, the more of it is exposed, and the mortar joints above the roofline are always the first thing to go. Caught early it is repointing; left alone it becomes a rebuild of the top courses.
loc.p-2: Wood-burning fireplaces are still in regular use in these houses, so a yearly sweep and a look at the liner is usually part of the same visit.

svc.h2: What High Park & Roncesvalles Homeowners Book Most
svc.p: Every job starts with the free 19-point inspection, so you only pay for what the chimney actually needs.
svc.p-2: FixesOpen mortar joints, flaking brick, a worn crown.
svc.p-3: Repointed and matched to your brick.

img-2.alt: Fireplace after a Northmark chimney sweep, floor clean

svc.p-4: FixesSoot and creosote building up in the flue.
svc.p-5: A cleaner-burning fireplace, and no mess left behind.

svc.p-6: FixesCracked crowns, damaged fireboxes, water getting in.
svc.p-7: Fixed once, with materials matched to your home.

faq.q: Do you charge to come out to High Park & Roncesvalles?
faq.p-2: No. The 19-point inspection at your home is free, and you get the photos and the report whether or not you go ahead with any work.
faq.q-2: Will the sweep make a mess in my house?
faq.p-3: No. Floors and the fireplace area are covered before any tool comes out, the vacuum runs while we sweep, and the area is left the way we found it — or cleaner.
faq.q-3: Do you work Saturdays and Sundays?
faq.p-4: Yes. Every day, {{site.hours}}, at the same price as a weekday.
faq.q-4: How much is a chimney sweep in High Park & Roncesvalles?
faq.p-5: A standard chimney sweep is {{site.offer_price}} this winter, with the free 19-point inspection included. Repairs are priced at your home after the inspection, before any work starts. Call {{site.phone}} and we will confirm it for your chimney.

near.p: Not on the list? Call and ask — we cover Toronto and most of the GTA.

book.p: Tell us what is going on with your chimney and we will come and look at it, free.
book.p-2: Every Day {{site.hours}}. If we miss your call, we call right back.
